newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish H1 privatisation inflows at two bln zlotys.
newsitem.headline: Polish H1 privatisation inflows at two bln zlotys.

text.p: Polish privatisation inflows in the first half of 1997 amounted to about two billion zlotys ($605 million), including 1.5 billion from the public offer of Bank Handlowy SA alone, the treasury minister said on Thursday.
Miroslaw Pietrewicz said 20 firms were privatised through share offerings to investors in the first half of the year and that another 20 projects could be completed by the end of 1997.

Pietrewicz later said that according to preliminary estimates the state treasury would be boosted by an additional 1.4 billion zlotys through the recent privatisation of copper concern KGHM Polska Miedz SA.
"Final results have not been made, but we estimate that inflows (from KGHM's flotation) would top 1.4 billion zlotys," he told a news conference.
